title: How do I organise references and create citations?
problem_statement: You have sources from many places and need to keep track of them and cite them correctly in your writing.
expected_outcome: A reference library and a document with correctly formatted in-text citations and bibliography.

steps.title: Install a reference manager
steps.instructions: Install Zotero and its plugin for your word processor (Word, LibreOffice or Google Docs).
steps.expected_result: Zotero running, with the plugin visible in your word processor.

steps.title: Save sources as you find them
steps.instructions: Save sources while browsing so their details are captured automatically. Add anything missing by hand.
steps.expected_result: Each source in your library with complete details.

steps.title: Organise
steps.instructions: Create a collection for this project and tag sources by theme.
steps.expected_result: Sources grouped so you can find them quickly.

steps.title: Cite while you write
steps.instructions: Insert citations through the plugin and choose the citation style you were asked to use, then generate the bibliography.
steps.expected_result: In-text citations and a bibliography in the required style.

quality_checks: Every in-text citation appears in the bibliography.
Author names, years and titles match the original sources.

editorial.author: V2 research pass (AI-assisted, Claude)
editorial.change_summary: Researched from official sources 2026-10-21; published under owner's blanket MVP approval (D-044). Domain-expert review pending.

common_mistakes: Mixing citation styles in one document
